Using the pipe operator
```{r}
my_numbers <- c(2, 4, 6, 8)
print(sum(my_numbers)) 
#View sum of numbers in the vector

my_numbers|>sum()
#Pipe operator passes values on its left into the function on its right

print(my_numbers |> sum() |> sqrt())
#Sum then square root

print(my_numbers |> sum() |> sqrt() |> round())
#Sum, square root then round to nearest integer (remember weird rules)

my_result <- my_numbers |> sum() |> sqrt() |> round()
print(my_result)

input_vec <- c(5, -10, 4, -3)
output_result <- input_vec |> mean() |> abs() |> round()
print
#Practice problem
```

Comparison operators
```{r}
y <- 12
print(y == 7)
print(y < 15)
print(y > 20)
print(y <= 12)

#Practising use of comparison operators
```
